Florida is considering redirecting $200 million in federal EV charging funds toward air taxi infrastructure, a policy shift that could accelerate eVTOL adoption [1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOZGdndGJ3VE53eXNZWUxmcTY4T2UtM0pLMzY3UENFaDNTT0lGMHRwdk1OdFZTMmJHbUFOZkNIVnJFMjRjZk5DVC1zT19IMkFmb01GR3ptVGdkUy1veVY0VmdvZTN3ck9qeVkxeDZLZFBLVWR3QzNub3BoeVdiNGZUVXRrWDZZQWR2?oc=5). The Federal Aviation Administration awarded $12 million for 19 drone research projects covering beyond visual line of sight operations, detect-and-avoid systems, and traffic management [2](https://dronelife.com/2026/10/05/faa-drone-research-funding-12-million/). Meanwhile, 15 U.S. states challenged the FAA’s environmental review of commercial drone package rules, and Attorney General Bonta sued the Trump Administration over a flawed environmental assessment for commercial drone delivery operations [3](https://www.uasvision.com/2026/10/02/us-states-challenge-faa-environmental-review-of-commercial-drone-package-rules/)[4](https://www.suasnews.com/2026/10/attorney-general-bonta-sues-trump-administration-over-flawed-environmental-assessment-for-commercial-drone-delivery-operations/).

In autonomous trucking, Kodiak AI targeted a year-end launch of driverless services on the Dallas-Houston corridor in partnership with IKEA [5](https://news.google.?oc=5). For rail, India launched its first LNG-powered train, capable of running up to 1,600 km without refueling, following earlier hydrogen train tests [6](https://news.google.?oc=5). In the defense sector, U.S. firm Powerus secured a $22.3 million contract to protect Middle East energy infrastructure from drone threats [7](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOdkEwbjNiZFB0T3dHOWluU2NNa001NzNUZ3lGS3NNbmFLWHdwejRUY2ZZdWJJU3pmVWlHd0VOUnd4NGZNOExha2RGUkJ6NzZtTlhzR1pUd1FQb0lCV2tIMlFMUkY4cnRHQmJmUXhWUHZ4YWNpRUVrQlZUcW9wNWYwYUJSdHpCMFRJeFFGMjBXY0ZPYmxfZ0R4c0FWWndtWVpoR3BlYnhCMndzNFBfQnBBcEVBRmw3M1JPLWJXNFlCTERPeU1MRlBFem1B?oc=5).

Walmart and Wing will expand drone deliveries to Denver and Seattle, offering to deliver thousands of items in as fast as 30 minutes [8](https://www.9news.com/article/money/business/walmart-delivery-drones-denver-seattle/73-05416c06-4973-43f5-a9c9-74e477783599). DoorDash stated its delivery drone is lighter and quieter than Amazon’s [9](https://www.uasvision.com/2026/10/05/doordash-says-delivery-drone-is-lighter-and-quieter-than-amazons/). In aerospace, NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission concluded with the crew’s return from the International Space Station [10](https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/iss-research/heading-home-nasas-spacex-crew-12-concludes-station-science-mission/). The X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft hit a new top speed [11](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPcTBtcmYtZnp5NldObm03a1oyZ3oxZkZzcHlEODYzV2NpZmp4QWdUa25FcC1GSDNPbkI5Vm5nWmd5eXBvaDNPUXhuTzBLOHQ3YmRZczl0dWNWaWxiYmxNUVhTZzAzdjYyLS1tQmJPZll0SVNibktDS3RjQVFRY0pEZ09ZbzBjMjMzYjY5Q3pzSm13a0tyZXY0?oc=5).
